name: COWAY Co., Ltd.
summary: COWAY Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of environmental home appliances in South Korea, the United States, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company provides air purifiers, water purifiers, air conditioning, bidets, water softeners, dehumidifier, humidifiers, kitchen/home appliances, mattress/massage chair, clothing care system, food waste disposers, and filter/replacement. It also engages in the rental and sale of water purifiers and cosmetics; manufacture of furniture; industrial water supply construction and operation; funeral agency; and manufacture industrial equipment such as water treatment equipment.
